name: Money Masters Leasing & Finance Limited
about: Money Masters Leasing & Finance Limited, a non-banking financial company, engages in leasing and finance business in India. The company offers hire-purchase loans for vehicles, auto rickshaws, equipment, and small-ticket assets. It is also involved in the acceptance of deposits and lending for retail, SMEs, and commercial customers, as well as gold loan financing. In addition, the company offers loans for personal, domestic appliances, and asset purchase to individuals. Money Masters Leasing & Finance Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Mumbai, India.Money Masters Leasing & Finance Limited, a non-banking financial company, engages in leasing and finance business in India.
